title: Questions and comments on guidelines

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Give designers a clear help route so uncertain applications can be resolved before inconsistent work spreads.
strategic_value: Separating central guideline questions from division-specific material questions can support Helsinki’s shared identity.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture provides a central specialist contact and directs division-specific questions to the relevant graphic designers.
practical_value: Route a general guideline question centrally and a division-material question to the division’s specialists.

content_islands.name: General support
content_islands.spec: Place the named central contact with the guideline-question instruction.

content_islands.name: Division support
content_islands.spec: Keep the separate route for local application and material questions below.

reference_purposes.Application: The text distinguishes central guideline assistance from division-specific help.
